infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: IA Chérie requires camera access for professional video content creation, live streaming, and advanced visual content capture with AI-powered enhancement.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: IA Chérie requires microphone access for high-quality audio recording, voice content creation, and advanced audio processing with AI enhancement.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: IA Chérie requires photo library access to import, enhance, and distribute your existing content with AI-powered protection and optimization.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: IA Chérie saves your created and enhanced content to your photo library for easy access and sharing across platforms.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: IA Chérie uses location data to provide geo-targeted content optimization, platform-specific distribution, and location-based analytics insights.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: IA Chérie uses Face ID for secure authentication, protecting your valuable content and revenue data with enterprise-grade biometric security.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: IA Chérie accesses contacts to facilitate collaboration invitations and streamline professional networking for content creators.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: IA Chérie integrates with your calendar to schedule content uploads, manage publishing schedules, and optimize posting times.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: IA Chérie uses tracking data to provide personalized content recommendations, optimize platform performance, and deliver targeted analytics insights for your content strategy.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: IA Chérie uses speech recognition for voice-to-text transcription, automated captions, and voice command functionality to enhance content creation workflow.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: IA Chérie uses motion sensors for advanced camera stabilization, gesture-based controls, and immersive content creation features.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: IA Chérie discovers and connects to local devices for content transfer, wireless collaboration, and professional studio equipment integration.
